'''Roger Simon Bivand''' (born 5 April 1951) is a British [[geographer]], [[economist]] and professor at the [[Norwegian School of Economics]]. He specialises in [[Open-source software|open source software]] for [[spatial analysis]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Roger Bivand|url=https://www.nhh.no/en/employees/faculty/roger-bivand/|access-date=2020-11-02|publisher=[[Norwegian School of Economics]]|language=en}}</ref> and played a major role in developing functions for spatial data in the [[R (programming language)|R statistical programming language]], including the [[R packages]] sp, rgdal, maptools and rgrass7.<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Lovelace|first1=Robin|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=0y6ODwAAQBAJ|title=Geocomputation with R|last2=Nowosad|first2=Jakub|last3=Muenchow|first3=Jannes|date=2019-03-22|publisher=CRC Press|isbn=978-1-351-39689-9|pages=5–7|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Roger Bivand|url=https://opengeohub.org/people/roger-bivand|access-date=2020-11-02|website=OpenGeoHub Foundation}}</ref> His book ''Applied Spatial Data Analysis with R'' (2008), coauthored with [[Edzer Pebesma]] and [[Virgilio Gómez-Rubio]], is considered "the authoritative resource on R's spatial capabilities".<ref name="Lovelace 2015">{{cite journal |last1=Lovelace |first1=Robin |title=Book Review: Advanced Spatial Data Analysis with R, R. Bivand, E. Pebesma and V. Gomez-Rubio, Second Edition, Springer, Softcover and eBook, 405 pages, 2013 |journal=Applied Spatial Analysis and Policy |date=1 March 2015 |volume=8 |issue=1 |pages=85–87 |doi=10.1007/s12061-014-9118-y |bibcode=2015ApSAP...8...85L |s2cid=255506437 |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12061-014-9118-y |language=en |issn=1874-4621|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

==Education and career==

Bivand was born in [[Bristol]] on 5 April 1951.<ref>{{Cite web|last1=Brunstad|first1=Rolf|last2=Vatne|first2=Eirik|date=2011-04-05|title=Roger S. Bivand 60 år|url=http://paraplyen.nhh.no/paraplyen/arkiv/2011/april/roger-s-bi/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160306012357/http://paraplyen.nhh.no/paraplyen/arkiv/2011/april/roger-s-bi/|archive-date=2016-03-06|access-date=2020-11-02|website=Paraplyen|publisher=[[Norwegian School of Economics]]|language=no}}</ref> He studied geography at the [[University of Cambridge]] and obtained his PhD from the [[London School of Economics]] in 1975,<ref name=":0" /> with a [[doctoral thesis|thesis]] on the [[economic geography]] of [[Sogn og Fjordane]] in Norway.<ref>{{cite thesis|last=Bivand|first=Roger|date=1990|title=The economic geography of regional differentiation: studies in Sogn og Fjordane, Norway|type=PhD|publisher=London School of Economics and Political Science|url=https://etheses.lse.ac.uk/3210/}}</ref> He went on to receive a [[habilitation]] from the [[Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań]] in 1982.<ref name=":0" /> 

Bivand joined the Norwegian School of Economics in 1988 and was appointed a professor in 1996.<ref name=":0" /> In 1991-92 he was the director of the Business School (MBA studies) of the Warsaw University of Technology (Poland). He has been an editor of several academic journals, including the ''[[Journal of Statistical Software]]'', ''[[The R Journal]]'', the ''[[Journal of Geographical Systems]]'', ''[[Geographical Analysis (journal)|Geographical Analysis]]'' and the ''[[Norwegian Journal of Geography]]''.<ref name=":0" /> In 2018 he received a Lifetime Achievement Award from the OpenGeoHub Foundation.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2018-08-24|title=Life Achievement Award for prof. dr. Roger Bivand|url=https://opengeohub.org/life-achievement-award-prof-dr-roger-bivand|access-date=2020-11-02|website=OpenGeoHub Foundation}}</ref>
